evidence_class: mocked signals and isolated fakeredis; no live Kubernetes, SSH or rollout proof
interfaces: Signal, Source, Reading, Thresholds and Mode
classify returning Classification with State, Terminal, Failure, Confidence, observed_at, confirmed_at, classified_at, denied sources, suspect_since, proof_since and needs_operator
Observer.observe, get, records, audit and execution_observation_age_seconds; ObservationRefused carries error_class and retryable
scripts.swarm.status.observation, carried as the observation field of every agent row in status_report

supported_versions.runtime_protocol: SV2-RUN-01 to SV2-RUN-03 unchanged; observation classification introduced by SV2-RUN-04
supported_versions.record: Redis hash observations keyed by execution id, holding the latest reading per source; a write is refused when its classification time is older than the stored one; lost transitions append to the observation-audit list; both are retained by swarm snapshots

authority: Observation is a read path. Observer acts only on executions of its own backend that are the current occupant of their seat by execution id and generation (forbidden_scope and stale_generation refusals); signals naming another execution or generation are discarded and counted. No display label and no operator grant is consulted; operator grant derivation applies to the mutation paths of later packages.

classification.terminal_loss: fresh heartbeat with unreachable terminal: working, terminal degraded
classification.worker_loss: stale heartbeat with a running Pod: suspect without proof, never lost. Pod ended or deleted, or supervisor exited: suspect with proof_since; lost only when that proof has held lost_after_s since its first observation
classification.pod_scheduling: pending Pod without a fresh heartbeat: pending; a fresh heartbeat from a pending Pod is a suspect contradiction
classification.provider_wait: fresh heartbeat with provider quota_wait: waiting_quota
classification.observation_denied: forbidden or unauthenticated read: never classified as a deleted Pod, never lost
classification.observation_unavailable: unreachable or missing Kubernetes view: suspect, never lost
classification.starting: running Pod before any heartbeat: starting until the supervisor handshake, then working

states.committed: Implementation and fixture inputs committed on tested_commit; generated case manifest identifies exact input hashes.

rollback_rehearsal.action: Construct Observer with Thresholds.from_environ and AGENTIHOOKS_OBSERVATION_MODE=conservative: it never declares lost and marks every suspect attempt needs_operator, which the status observation projection shows for operator classification. The observations hash and audit list are retained; the local tick suspect path and RuntimeRouter are unchanged.
rollback_rehearsal.evidence: Case C restores a snapshot into a new store, recovers by relist with execution attempts and spawns unchanged, ignores a stale replay, then a conservative observer holds a deleted Pod as suspect needing the operator past the lost threshold.
rollback_rehearsal.wiring: No production caller constructs Observer at G1, so the switch takes effect when the adapter package that produces signals constructs it.

remaining_limitations: No Kubernetes, SSH or supervisor signal producer exists at G1; signals are fixture built. Backend adapters in later packages produce them and construct Observer.
The tick still uses its existing remote suspect path; routing tick suspect and lost decisions through Observer belongs to later runtime packages.
Lost is recorded with an audit entry; fencing the old generation on lost is the controller claim path of later packages, not this observer.
ObservationRefused carries the section 13.4 error class and retry classification; observations have no operation id because they mutate no runtime object.
Legacy local agents without an execution record project their heartbeat only, as state unclassified; with no heartbeat, observed_at is null and sources empty.
The required fixture stale heartbeat with running Pod is exercised in case C and the unit tests; case B covers forbidden and unauthenticated reads; case A covers fresh heartbeat with SSH failure.

Section 13.4 operation ids and section 4.2 old generation fencing on lost are not part of this read path, and no command records an operator classification for a needs_operator attempt yet; both are proposed on the ledger for the operator to decide.
next_action: Produce signals from the Kubernetes adapter and route tick suspect and lost decisions through Observer.
decisions: A fresh heartbeat without a supervisor handshake classifies as working with partial confidence. Section 4.2 ties working to a confirmed main-agent identity, but the T-SV2-RUN-04-A output contract requires a terminal disconnect with fresh worker heartbeats to leave the task working; heartbeats are written by the main agent's own hooks, so the acceptance contract governs and the confidence field carries the weaker identity proof.

Each observation merges new signals into the stored latest reading per source; an older signal for a source is ignored, so a stale cursor cannot overwrite newer evidence while an empty batch still reclassifies known evidence as time passes.
Confirmed confidence needs an agreeing Kubernetes or supervisor reading inside fresh_s; older remembered readings stay visible in sources with their own observed_at but no longer confirm.
compatibility: Status report agent rows keep every earlier field and add observation, asserted by the status report rows test. SV2-RUN-01 to SV2-RUN-03 interfaces are unchanged.
review: Standards and Spec readers ran three rounds. Standards held one low finding: the watched write loop duplicates the operations journal loop; kept because sharing it would change the SV2-RUN-03 module outside this package.
mutation_resolution: First CI mutation run left 18 survivors in observe. Remembered readings became an identity free Seen record and OK values a mapping, removing three equivalent mutants. Tests added for the freshness boundary, empty evidence time, the recovered flag, the record and audit keys, an unoccupied seat, accumulated discards, audit of several executions, a same time reclassification, the audit at the lost transition and exact refusal messages. No mutation clearances used.
